snippet.title: This 90s Arcade Game Looked Like Dragon Ball Z Meets Aliens: Thunder Hoop Collection
snippet.description:
Two unhinged 90s Spanish arcade cult classics, finally revived for modern consoles. Thunder Hoop Collection launches worldwide on October 8, 2026!

Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4448240/Thunder_Hoop_Collection_QUByte_Classics/utm_source=youtube

Experience the complete bio-nightmare saga created by Gaelco, S.A.! Thunder Hoop Collection brings together both arcade hits: the original 1992 platform-shooter Thunder Hoop and its chaotic 1994 two-player sequel, TH Strikes Back.

Take down the twisted experiments of the rogue genetic designer Professor Genbreak. Blast through hordes of grotesque bio-mutants inspired by 80s and 90s sci-fi cinema, jump across hazardous platforms, unleash devastating energy attacks, and stop a global catastrophe!

LAUNCH DETAILS:
Release Date: October 8, 2026
Price: $9.99 USD
Platforms: PC (Steam, Epic Games Store), PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch
